title: N38+N41+N42: Paper edits — QLIKE normalization, 2026 Basel caveat, new citations
description: Fixed three paper issues: (1) N38: QLIKE values in Section 4.6.1 used inconsistent normalization (0.540 instead of -9.034). Re-ran experiments to get correct values: w=378 -9.042, w=504 -9.034, w=1000 -8.994, w=2000 -9.021, w=5000 -9.047. U-shape confirmed. (2) N41: Removed Basel III Green Zone claim from 49-day 2026 data. Now explicitly states 49 days is too short for formal classification. (3) N42: Added Zakamulin 2014, Zhu-Kuan 2016, Charalampopoulos 2025 citations. Also fixed duplicate Secti
